name: Sangram Maharana/ ସଂଗ୍ରାମ ମହାରଣା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sangram Maharana writes poetry in Odia. In “ନକ୍ସା”, the poem gathered here, a house becomes a map of remembered affection: its approach, steps, wall niches and roof hold the traces of an uncertain relationship.

The speaker recalls a hidden first letter, a guava tree and a garden that becomes a boundary. These precise domestic details give longing a physical shape. The invitation to draw a map together gradually turns towards correction and erasure, leaving the hoped-for intimacy suspended between what can be remembered and what can still be said.
